Design Audit · claude design — mockups

The editorial redesign, shipped and measured.

Nine standalone design mockups in claude design - mockups/ were decoded and compared, one by one, against the live implementation of every corresponding screen in the Strummy codebase. Every mockup has a real, route-mounted counterpart — so this is a fidelity & gap analysis, not a "was it built" audit.

00 At a glance

Each mockup is a self-contained Claude artifact bundle — a manifest of gzip-compressed JSX design source plus fonts, self-unpacking in the browser. The named "focus" files (Lesson Detail/Form/List, Assignment Form, Student Form) carry a small component set; the others (Assignments, Song Form A/B) embed the entire design system (~33 screens: landing, auth, onboarding, dashboards, settings, fretboard…). Collectively they are one coherent editorial redesign. The table maps each mockup to the live route and component that implements it, with a fidelity verdict.

Mockup Live route Component Fidelity

01 Cross-cutting patterns

The same four themes recur across every screen. Read these first — the per-screen sections below are instances of them.

🎨 Design-system port is faithful

Every CSS variable the mockups reference (--gold, --ink, --paper, --serif, --gold-tint) exists verbatim in editorial-tokens.css with matching semantics. Section chrome (numeral + serif title + populated/count pill), the sticky 1fr / 320px preview rail, and typography are near pixel-faithful across all forms.

Uniformly high fidelity

🕹️ Crafted widgets → native controls

The mockups' most-designed interactions were repeatedly downgraded to plain HTML: multi-student pill selectors → single <select> (Assignment & Lesson forms), the checkbox song-card grid → <select multiple>, split Date/Time → one datetime-local. Structure survives; interaction craft is thinner.

Recurring on every form

🚧 "Hero" moments unbuilt

The showcase interactions simply aren't there: Start live lesson, the song audio player (waveform/loop), tablature, the student practice-log chart + record-audio submission, and the Music Manuscript song-form direction. The CRUD skeleton shipped; the signature experiences didn't.

Biggest scope gap

🧩 Schema-ready, UI-unbuilt

Several DB columns exist but nothing renders them: gallery_images, audio_files, and — most notably — lyrics_with_chords is written by both song forms but read by no screen. Server actions quickAssign/bulkAssignSongsFromLesson exist but no component calls them. The data plumbing is ahead of the UI.

Latent / low-cost to finish

➕ Implementation out-runs the mockups

Production added a lot the design never drew: dark mode, assignment templates · checklist · chord-drill, AI assist across forms, URL-driven filter/search/sort, a MonthCalendar, role-aware views, and real Zod validation + API wiring. Net functionality exceeds the mockups even where visual fidelity dips.

Value beyond spec

🔀 Two directions, one committed

Song Form shipped as a clean, unblended Direction A ("Editorial single-page") — exact 1fr 320px grid, roman-numeral sections, boxed inputs, per-section completion tracker. Direction B ("Music Manuscript": Canto numerals, dark score-card, mobile wizard) left no trace in the codebase.

Decisive, documented here

02 Assignments

2.1

Assignment Form

Strummy - Assignment Form (Standalone).html
MOCKUP — dedicated create/edit form: I·WHO multi-student pills, II·WHAT, III·WHEN, IV·PROOF, sticky preview
Route /dashboard/assignments/new · /[id]/edit Component AssignmentCreate.tsx Maturity mounted · live
Design intent
  • Full-page form in a sidebar+topbar shell; italic-serif "New assignment." header with Cancel / "Send assignment" actions.
  • Two-column 1fr / 320px grid with a sticky live preview (song title, student pills, due-date summary).
  • Four numbered sections: I·WHO (multi-student pill/avatar toggle), II·WHAT (song select + task description), III·WHEN (due date + daily target), IV·PROOF (submission-type segmented control).
Faithful matches
  • Grid ratio reproduced exactly via .ed-grid-form; FormSection mirrors the mockup's SectionF chrome 1:1.
  • Sticky FormPreviewPanel matches the preview card; submission-type toggle is pixel-faithful (same 4 options + selected-state).
  • Daily-target options identical (5/10/15/20 min/day); preview shows song (italic serif) + student + due date.
Divergences & gaps
  • Multi- → single student. Mockup assigns one task to many students via pills; impl uses a single-select <select>, create-mode only — no bulk assign.
  • Sections consolidated 4 → ~2 (WHAT+WHEN merged; PROOF absorbs checklist + chord-drill).
  • CTA reads "Create assignment" / "Save changes" — the mockup's "Send assignment" notification framing is gone.
Extras beyond the mockup
  • Template picker, checklist editor (≤20 sub-tasks), chord-drill editor, AI generator (flagged), "also save as template" — none in the mockup.
  • Field-level validation with focus-first-invalid.
High
Structural design language (grid, section chrome, sticky preview, submission toggle) is near pixel-faithful; the gaps are scope decisions (single vs multi-student) and the impl adds substantial functionality the mockup never envisioned.
2.2

Assignments — Teacher & Student views

Assignments Teacher / Student (Standalone).html
MOCKUP · TEACHER — split screen: assignment list (progress bars + status) beside an inline "quick assign" composer
MOCKUP · STUDENT — inbox + detail: task, weekly practice-log chart, chord-chart reference, "tip from Sarah", record-audio submit
Route /dashboard/assignments · /[id] Component AssignmentsList · AssignmentDetail Maturity mounted · role-shared
Design intent
  • Teacher: single-screen master-detail — tabbed list (Open / To review / Reviewed) with avatar + song + progress bar + status, beside an inline quick-assign composer (no navigation to create).
  • Student: list + rich detail — Task card, weekly practice-log bar chart, dashed record-audio dropzone + note, chord-chart reference, italic "Hint from Sarah".
  • Status model open → submitted → done with a teacher-review gate.
Faithful matches
  • Status-pill vocabulary (uppercase mono + colored dot + tint), list-row composition, overdue-in-red, and card chrome carry the editorial language faithfully.
  • Core actions exist — teacher "New assignment"; student status change.
Divergences & gaps
  • No split-pane master-detail. Impl uses two separate routes (list-only + detail-only); no inline composer — "New assignment" always navigates to the full form.
  • Review gate dropped. Impl status enum is not_started/in_progress/completed/overdue/cancelled; a student jumps straight to completed — no "submitted, awaiting review" state.
  • Missing: practice-log chart, chord-chart reference, hint card, and the audio-record / file-submission widget. Submission = checklist ticks + status button, not media.
  • Progress metric differs — mockup = practice minutes; impl = checklist completion.
Extras beyond the mockup
  • Debounced search, student filter, multi-key sort; templates system (list/edit + "save as template"); chord-drill quiz & checklist as content types; status-change history timeline; cancel-with-confirmation.
Medium
Row-level visual vocabulary is faithful, but the page-level composition diverges — the signature single-screen master-detail and the whole media-submission / practice-tracking surface are replaced by simpler two-page navigation and self-certified completion, offset by a materially larger feature set.

03 Lessons

3.1

Lesson List

Strummy - Lesson List (Standalone).html
MOCKUP — filter chips with per-status counts + year + sort; dense desktop table (date · lesson · student · songs · time · status)
Route /dashboard/lessons Component LessonsList.tsx Maturity mounted · live
Design intent
  • Role-aware header + status filter chips (with counts) + year select + sort toggle.
  • Desktop table: date block · #num + title + notes preview · student(avatar+level) · teacher · songs (count + up-to-4 status dots) · time · status pill.
  • A separate mobile artboard: phone frame, date-grouped headers, scrollable filter pills, per-lesson cards, floating "+" FAB.
Faithful matches
  • Filter row is a near-1:1 port; table columns match cell-for-cell (incl. the up-to-4 song status dots); header structure and 4-state status colors identical.
Divergences & gaps
  • No true mobile redesign — the grid just collapses to one column; no date-grouped cards, scrollable pills, or FAB.
  • Impl defaults to time-bucketed groups (Today/This week/…) vs the mockup's one flat sorted table; filters are URL round-trips vs instant client state.
  • "Recurring…" list action dropped (moved into the New Lesson form); status pill uses one flat tint instead of per-status color.
Extras beyond the mockup
  • Full MonthCalendar alternate view; role-tailored empty states; bookmarkable/shareable URL filter state.
High
Desktop table and filter bar are close to a pixel-level port; pulled down only by the entirely missing mobile-card experience and the dropped "Recurring…" action.
3.2

Lesson Detail

Strummy - Lesson Detail (Standalone).html
MOCKUP — hero with date tile + "Start live lesson"; Songs w/ 5-stage steppers + notes&history; Info / Assignments / Continuity rail
Route /dashboard/lessons/[id] Component LessonDetail.tsx Maturity mounted · live
Design intent
  • Breadcrumb bar with Start live lesson (gold), Recap email, Edit, delete; hero with a large DateBlock tile + status.
  • Left: Songs card (key badge + 5-stage StageStepper + expandable "Notes & history"), Lesson notes. Right: Info · Assignments (with "Quick-assign from all N songs") · Continuity (streak + HealthDot).
  • Separate mobile artboard with full-width "Start live lesson" CTA.
Faithful matches
  • Card composition and order reproduced exactly; the 5-stage song stepper is an exact match (keys/labels/colors, click-to-advance for teachers).
  • Info, Assignments, and Continuity cards match 1:1; status pill convention consistent with the list.
Divergences & gaps
  • Start live lesson is entirely unbuilt — no component/route/action anywhere.
  • No DateBlock graphic (plain mono eyebrow instead); no delete, no manual Recap email button (recap fires via a DB trigger), no "+ Add song".
  • Per-song notes & history missing; Quick-assign exists as server actions but no UI calls them; Continuity drops the streak/HealthDot footer.
  • Responsive bug: the two-column grid is an inline style, not .ed-grid-hero, so it won't collapse under the 860px breakpoint — no mobile layout compensates.
Extras beyond the mockup
  • AI post-lesson summary (flagged); student & song names are live links to their detail pages.
Medium
Composition and the song-progress stepper are precisely reproduced, but several signature interactions (live mode, recap button, delete, per-song history, add-song, quick-assign hookup) are missing, plus a real non-collapsing-grid responsive bug the other editorial screens avoid.
3.3

Lesson Form

Strummy - Lesson Form (Standalone).html
MOCKUP — I·WHO&WHEN student pills + date/time; II·FORMAT in-person/video + repeats; III·PLAN checkbox song-card grid; sticky preview
Route /dashboard/lessons/new · /[id]/edit Component LessonForm.tsx Maturity mounted · live
Design intent
  • Two-column form with sticky preview; I·WHO&WHEN (avatar-pill student picker + separate Date & Time + duration), II·FORMAT (in-person/video toggle + repeats switch), III·PLAN (2-col checkbox song-card grid), IV·NOTES.
Faithful matches
  • Numbered FormSection + populated/count badge mirrors SectionF; sticky preview reproduced near-verbatim; in-person/video toggle matches almost exactly.
Divergences & gaps
  • Student pills → <select>; Date + Time → one datetime-local; checkbox song-card grid → <select multiple> (⌘-click) — the three most-crafted widgets all downgraded.
  • Sections regrouped (Format folded into Section I; "Location & recurrence" pairing gone); an extra Status select added; student field is create-only.
  • Repeats changed from an inline toggle to a checkbox + weeks-count select, create-mode only; actions moved to form bottom (no FormShell).
Extras beyond the mockup
  • Inline "+ New student by email"; configurable recurring generation (exact week count) via a real server action; AI notes; validated submit pipeline.
Medium
Macro-shape (numbered sections, sticky preview, format toggle) is faithful, but the avatar-pill student picker and the checkbox song-card grid — the mockup's two signature widgets — became plain native controls; structural fidelity high, interaction-craft fidelity noticeably down.

04 Songs

4.1

Song Form A — "Editorial single-page"

Strummy - Song Form A (Standalone).html
MOCKUP · DIRECTION A (shipped) — Spotify accelerator + roman-numeral boxed sections + sticky preview & completion tracker
Route /dashboard/songs/new Component SongForm.tsx Maturity mounted · this direction shipped
Design intent
  • Green Spotify accelerator (auto-fills 8 fields, "AUTO-FILLED" pill); 4 collapsible roman-numeral sections (Essentials / Resources / Musical / Content), boxed inputs, gold-tinted auto-fields.
  • Content section includes a multi-image gallery; right rail = sticky preview + per-section completion tracker.
Faithful matches
  • Exact 1fr 320px grid + "I · ROMAN-NUMERAL" scheme + boxed inputs + per-section completion tracker = unmistakably Direction A.
  • Functional Spotify auto-fill, advisory duplicate warning ("View existing →"), live preview card, AI teaching-notes buttons, category datalist.
Divergences & gaps
  • Field groupings reshuffled (difficulty/key → Musical; category → Resources; cover → Essentials); sections not collapsible.
  • Auto-filled fields never visually distinguished (mockup gold-highlights them); accelerator styled gold not green, no album-art result card / "AUTO-FILLED" pill.
  • No multi-image gallery — single cover only, though gallery_images exists in the DB. No Cancel button. Edit form drops Notes/AI + accelerator; its lyrics field is uncontrolled.
Extras beyond the mockup
  • Live inline chord-diagram thumbnails; fully interactive strumming-pattern editor; real Spotify/duplicate endpoints; Supabase Storage cover upload; Zod per-field errors.
High-Med
Unmistakably Direction A with zero Direction-B DNA, elevated in places (chord/strumming interactivity, AI) — but field groups were reorganized, the auto-fill affordance dropped, and the gallery never built.
4.2

Song Form B — "Music Manuscript"

Strummy - Song Form B (Standalone).html
MOCKUP · DIRECTION B (not taken) — masthead "A new song, transcribed."; CANTO numerals; borderless serif fields; dark score-card
Route — Component not built Maturity abandoned direction
Design intent
  • Manuscript aesthetic: staff-line masthead, "CANTO I–IV" numerals, borderless underline serif fields, key as a giant glyph, inline full-size chord diagrams, syntax-highlighted lyrics, a dark score-card preview with one aggregate completion bar, and a distinct 4-step mobile Canto wizard.
What B specified that isn't in the app
  • None of B's visual vocabulary shipped — no underline fields, no CANTO scheme, no dark score-card, no aggregate completion bar, no syntax-highlighted lyrics, no mobile step-wizard.

Abandoned (by design)
The team committed fully to Direction A. This mockup is documented here as the road not taken — every distinctive Manuscript idiom is completely absent from the codebase, which is a clean decision, not drift.

05 Students

5.1

Student Form

Strummy - Student Form (Standalone).html
MOCKUP — I·IDENTITY · II·CONTACT · III·SCHEDULE · IV·BILLING; sticky preview (avatar, level, lesson slot, rate)
Route /dashboard/users/new Component CreateStudentForm.tsx Maturity mounted · admin/teacher-gated
Design intent
  • Two-column form; four sections — I Identity (name, instrument, level segmented, start date, avatar-color swatches), II Contact (student email/phone, parent name/email), III Schedule (day/time/duration), IV Billing (rate, cycle, goals).

Divergences & gaps
  • Field count is a genuine 1:1 match (no hidden field bloat here) — but sections aren't collapsible (production FormSection is purely presentational: no chevron/toggle).
  • "Parent email required" intent dropped — the mockup gold-tints it as required; impl marks only name + level mandatory at submit.

06 Shared editorial design system

How the mockups' inline-style primitives were productionized into a reusable token system in app/editorial-tokens.css + components/_ui/*.

Tokens · verbatim + dark mode

Every variable the mockups use exists in .theme-editorial: colors (--ivory/--paper/--card, --ink..ink-5, --rule, the --gold* scale), fonts (--serif Fraunces, --sans Geist, --mono). The mockups are light-only; production adds a full parallel dark palette — a real extra, not a filter-invert.

Inline styles → ed-* utilities

Because React inline styles can't express :hover, :focus-visible or @media, the mockups' fixed-1440 frames became responsive utility classes: .ed-grid-form (1fr 320px), .ed-grid-hero, .ed-grid-2 — all collapsing under 860px — plus .ed-row / .ed-chip hover+focus states the static mockups never had.

Chrome shared, content local

Structural chrome was lifted into shared components (FormSection, FormPreviewPanel, FormAvatar); per-form preview content stays domain-local. Reasonable split. Two minor debts: field-style constants live in both _ui/form-styles.ts and a domain-local StudentFields.shared.tsx (drift risk), and FormSection shed the mockups' collapsibility.

07 Prioritized action list

The concrete, fixable items surfaced by the comparison — ordered defects first, then unbuilt-but-designed features, then latent (schema-ready) wiring. Everything here is a deliberate follow-up candidate, not a bug in what shipped.

Defect Lyrics are written but never displayed

lyrics_with_chords is captured by both the create and edit song forms, but no screen reads it back — not Song Detail, not any tab. Teachers can enter lyrics that are visible nowhere in the product. Either surface a Lyrics view (mockup's Lyrics tab) or remove the input.

Defect Lesson Detail two-column grid can't go responsive

The main grid uses an inline gridTemplateColumns style instead of .ed-grid-hero, so it won't collapse at the 860px breakpoint and there's no mobile layout to compensate. Swap the inline style for the utility class.

Defect "Parent email required" rule not enforced

The Student Form mockup marks parent email as required (for under-18s); the impl leaves it optional (only name + level are mandatory). Decide the rule and align the validation + gold-tint affordance.

Unbuilt "Start live lesson" mode

The mockup's flagship gold CTA on Lesson Detail (and the tablet/live artboards) has no component, route or action anywhere. Largest single missing interaction across all mockups.

Unbuilt Song Detail media surface — audio player · tablature · sections/progressions

Roughly half the Song Detail content is undrawn in code: waveform/loop audio player, the 6-string tablature view, and the bar-by-bar Sections & progressions breakdown.

Unbuilt Student assignment submission — practice chart & record-audio

The student assignment view has no weekly practice-log chart, no record-audio/file dropzone, no chord-chart reference, no teacher hint card, and no "submitted → teacher review" gate. Submission is currently self-certified status change + checklist ticks.

Downgrade Crafted form widgets → native controls

Restore, where it matters: avatar-pill student pickers (Assignment + Lesson forms) instead of <select>; the checkbox song-card grid instead of <select multiple>; multi-student assignment; split Date/Time.

Latent Quick-assign server actions have no UI

quickAssignSongFromLesson / bulkAssignSongsFromLesson are fully implemented in lessons/actions.ts but no component calls them — the mockup's dashed "Quick-assign from all N songs" CTA on Lesson Detail just needs wiring.

Latent Song gallery images — DB column, no UI

gallery_images exists and is read on the detail page's data layer, but the form only manages a single cover. The mockup's multi-image gallery grid would light up an existing column.

Latent Polish affordances

Gold-highlight Spotify auto-filled fields; restore per-status pill tints on the Lesson List; re-add section collapsibility to FormSection; consolidate the duplicated field-style constants; add missing Cancel / Delete / "+ Add song" affordances.
